title: The Returned Wedding Dress
narration: A dry cleaner returned my wedding dress covered in fresh blood. The receipt said my missing husband had delivered it yesterday. Police arrived after finding his blood in my car, but the gown vanished from beneath my bed. I found him alive inside the wardrobe. He thanked me for letting detectives see me hide it, then escaped through a concealed door and tossed me his phone. The silence felt deliberate, as though someone nearby was waiting for me to understand the trap before moving again. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. Every explanation I tried made the details worse, because each clue had been placed where I alone would find it. His final message to the lead detective promised they could be together once I was convicted.
